headline: AI-Augmented Software Trainer & Mentor | AI-Driven Software Co-Creation
about: Passionate about technology education, community engagement, and inclusive talent growth. As an AI-Augmented Software Trainer and Workshop Coordinator, my mission is to transform how we learn and interact with technology—shifting the paradigm from simply "writing code" to mastering critical thinking, architectural design, and human-AI co-creation.

Technical Discretion & Code Auditing: I empower students, tech professionals, and diverse audiences to become the "conductors" of AI. Specializing in Python, AI tools, and Cybersecurity (including social engineering, network security, and ethical hacking), I teach how to understand the logic behind the code, debug AI hallucinations, and architect resilient software solutions.

Human Connection, Resilience & STEAM Advocacy: Technology moves fast, but human resilience, collective creativity, and managing developer friction are irreplaceable. I have a proven track record of leading high-impact, interactive sessions for local tech communities, high schools, and tier-1 global events like the Mobile World Congress. I am deeply committed to managing technical frustration, fostering inclusion, and empowering underrepresented groups—especially young women—to thrive in STEAM.
